My experience with this product was not as positive as I had hoped. Ingredients The serum contains some well-known beneficial ingredients like Sodium Ascorbyl Phosphate (a stable form of Vitamin C) and Hyaluronic Acid, which are known for their brightening and hydrating properties, respectively. However, it also includes various fruit and fragrance oils. Performance Upon application, the serum felt lightweight and absorbed quickly into my skin without leaving any sticky residue. Initially, I was pleased with how my skin felt moisturized and had a subtle glow. However, after a few days of use, I started to notice small bumps forming on my skin. As someone with sensitive skin, I suspect the fruit and fragrance oils might have triggered this reaction. Sensitivity Concerns If you have sensitive skin like mine, this product may not be the best choice. The bumps could likely be due to irritation from the oils, which are known to be potential irritants for sensitive skin types. While the Vitamin C and Hyaluronic Acid are beneficial, the added fragrance and fruit oils seemed to outweigh these benefits in my case. ### Conclu
